rules.name: IDENTITY
rules.statement: Cannlytics.id → record_id when present; else deterministic bridge ID. Bridge-generated IDs must not be implied to be upstream identifiers.

rules.name: SUBJECT_REQUIRED
rules.statement: Require subject_type + subject_id. subject_id priority: batch_number else sample_id else id. If none → STRUCTURALLY_UNMAPPABLE.

rules.name: SUBJECT_TYPE_CONSERVATIVE
rules.statement: Do NOT blindly infer subject_type. product_batch ONLY when product_type clearly manufactured/finished. flower/bud/biomass: never auto cultivation_batch; harvest_lot ONLY if metadata supports lot/harvest; else other + SUBJECT_TYPE_AMBIGUOUS. If only sample identity: subject_type=sample. product_name→subject.name only; NEVER product_name→cultivar.

rules.name: CULTIVAR_STRAIN_ONLY
rules.statement: strain_name→cultivar.reported_name with identity_status=reported only when strain_name present. Do not derive genetics from product_name, classification, indica_percentage, or sativa_percentage.

rules.name: DATES_DISTINCT
rules.statement: date_collected→collected_at; date_received→received_at; date_tested→tested_at; date_produced→produced_at. Never manufacture reported_at. date_expires→best_by ONLY if equivalence supported; otherwise omit.

rules.name: TRACEABILITY_METRC
rules.statement: metrc_lab_id→metrc.lab; metrc_source_id→metrc.source; metrc_ids→metrc.tag. Ambiguous traceability_ids → extension + TRACEABILITY_STRUCTURE_AMBIGUOUS.

rules.name: NUMERIC_POTENCY_AND_TERPENES
rules.statement: Top-level numeric % cannabinoids/terpenes → detected + unit %. Core keys mapped; others→cannabinoids.other[]. Never drop present numerics. No zero-fill for absent/null fields.

rules.name: RESULTDETAIL_STATES
rules.statement: Numeric value→detected (+ mg_g second unit). lod→LOD; loq→LOQ; generic limit→type=other + LIMIT_TYPE_AMBIGUOUS. status pass/fail→assessment ONLY (never auto result_state). status nt without raw 'Not Tested'→result_state=unknown, reported_as='nt', AMBIGUOUS_NT (never not_tested). Explicit ND→not_detected. Null without ND→unknown/omit + ND_UNRECOVERABLE. Explicit <LOQ/<LOD→below_reporting_limit. LOQ/LOD without qualifier→DO NOT infer below_limit (BELOW_LIMIT_STATE_AMBIGUOUS).

rules.name: PANEL_STATUS_NT
rules.statement: Panel pass/fail map to WeedDAO panel status. Panel nt→OMIT WeedDAO panel status + PANEL_NT_AMBIGUOUS; preserve nt in extensions.cannlytics_bridge.panel_nt_preserved. overall_status→outcomes/extension only; never map overall fail onto panel fail.

rules.name: PROVENANCE_AND_AUDIT_CLASS
rules.statement: extensions.cannlytics_bridge carries upstream_project, upstream_record_id, upstream_source, upstream_schema_commit, bridge_version. laboratory_verified only when indicated; bridge uses provenance=derived. Audit classes: LOSSLESS_FOR_AVAILABLE_SEMANTICS | SEMANTICALLY_PARTIAL | STRUCTURALLY_UNMAPPABLE. LOSSLESS means normalized Cannlytics semantics represented without guessing — NOT that the original COA was lossless.
